Harbourside Bank Easy Saver: Frequently Asked Questions

The Easy Saver account pays interest of 3.1 percent per year, paid monthly. You can open it with as little as 1 pound.

You can make up to four withdrawals per year without losing interest. After the fourth withdrawal, the rate drops to 1 percent for the rest of the year.

The account can be managed online, by phone, or in any branch.

Savings are protected up to 85,000 pounds by the national deposit guarantee scheme.
